**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Philosophy articles (any area of philosophy or environmental affairs) addressing questions of value or concept clarification in relation to environmental problems; explicitly bridges professional academic philosophy and non-professional/practitioner environmental-philosophy interest. No current (2024-2026) special-issue CFP was located.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** normative/ethical argumentation, conceptual analysis, critical/interpretive essays, short discussion notes/comments (up to 1000 words) responding to prior articles, book reviews

**Sources cited across this entry:**
- Reddit r/AskAcademia — no threads found discussing this journal by name
- https://cep.unt.edu/environmental-ethics/environmental-ethics-journal.html (publisher aims & scope + submission guidelines)

- https://www.pdcnet.org/enviroethics/Submission-Guidelines

- 小木虫 muchong.com — no discussion of this journal found (forum activity for 'Environmental Ethics' string only surfaces unrelated environmental-science journals, not this philosophy title)
- 知乎 zhihu.com — no discussion of this specific journal found; only tangential lists of 'environmental field' journals (environmental science, not environmental philosophy)

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **ai_policy.leniency_1_5 / ai_policy.gate**: No AI-use policy text found on cep.unt.edu submission guidelines or via search of pdcnet.org; this is a small humanities publisher (Philosophy Documentation Center) that does not appear to have published a public generative-AI policy, unlike the STEM environmental-science journals returned in searches (which are different journals, not this one).
- **preprint.allowed**: No preprint/self-archiving policy stated on the official submission-guidelines page found (cep.unt.edu); the canonical PDC submission-guidelines page at pdcnet.org/enviroethics/Submission-Guidelines returned HTTP 403 and could not be fetched to check further.
- **experiential.review_time_months, desk_reject_pct, acceptance_note, reviewer_culture**: SciRev page for this journal exists but has zero submitted reviews (explicit 'n/a' on all metrics). No discussion found on Reddit r/AskAcademia, 小木虫, 知乎, or general web search. Journal is a niche philosophy-of-environment quarterly, evidently below the visibility threshold for these community-review platforms which skew toward STEM/social-science submitters.
- **positioning.accepts_now (recent article titles)**: Attempted to pull the Online First / recent TOC list from pdcnet.org/enviroethics/onlinefirst to ground 'accepts now' in actual 2024-2026 titles, but the page returned HTTP 403 (login-gated). Positioning is therefore based only on the publisher's stated aims-and-scope language, not verified against current article titles — signal_quality downgraded to 2 accordingly.
